text: Ask anything. Enso picks the model.
Hanzo Chat searches the web, runs code, reads your files and makes images, in one conversation.
A chat that does the work, not just the talking
Enso sends each question to the model that answers it best. Pick one by name whenever you want to.
It searches the web for what is current and runs code when an answer needs working out.
Add a document, a sheet or a picture and ask about it in the same conversation.
Dictate a question or talk it through, and listen to the answer.
Tell it what to remember, and it carries that into the next conversation.
When a conversation turns into building, Dev is one press away in the same app.
